summary.tagline: Ásbyrgi (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈausˌpɪrcɪ]) is a glacial canyon and forest in the north of Iceland, locate

days.title: Canyon Floor and Nature
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: See
stops.detail: At the end of the 3.5 km long and approx. 1.1 km wide canyon, you will find a small lake with a rich duck population.

stops.name: Botnslækjarfoss
stops.detail: This waterfall (Botnslækjarfoss) is only clearly visible after the snow melts and after heavy rainfall.

stops.name: Mischwäldchen
stops.detail: In addition, there is a mixed forest here that is rather rare for Iceland (mainly birch, willow, rowan, and also spruce) with trees that in some cases reach a height of over eight meters.

stops.name: Eyjan
stops.detail: In front of the entrance to the canyon lies the approx. 25 m high rock Eyjan (Icelandic for island) on the plain.

stops.name: Besucherzentrum
stops.detail: There is also a visitor center, an e-charging station, and a gas station with a small supermarket and fast-food snack bar.
